meta.name: Fluent Design (Windows 11)
meta.description: Windows 11 / Fluent 2 desktop language for DubBitig: Mica window surfaces, Acrylic flyouts, 4px controls, quiet neutral hierarchy with a single accent.
source_references: Windows App SDK / WinUI 3 theme resources (Common_themeresources_any.xaml): fill, stroke, text and accent brushes
UI/UX Pro Max styles.csv: fluent-2; stacks/winui.csv: 'Choose Mica vs Acrylic by surface lifetime'

color.palette_type: monochromatic neutrals with a single accent

primary.role: Windows default accent (AccentFillColorDefault, light): accent buttons, selection pill, focused text box underline, links

accent.role: the only call-to-action colour; Windows uses one accent everywhere

neutral.usage: #F3F3F3 Mica window base; #EEEEEE navigation pane; #FBFBFB cards and controls (ControlFillColorDefault over Mica); #F9F9F9 control hover; #EAEAEA subtle hover / selected navigation item; #E5E5E5 card and control stroke; #868686 text box bottom stroke and switch outline (ControlStrongStroke); #6E6E6E tertiary text raised from WinUI's #8B8B8B to meet 4.5:1; #5F5F5F secondary text; #1A1A1A primary text (TextFillColorPrimary)

color.contrast_strategy: subtle layers: near-white cards on light grey Mica, separation by 1px stroke rather than shadow; text contrast at least 4.5:1

dark_mode.neutral_usage: #202020 Mica base; #1C1C1C navigation pane; #2B2B2B cards; #2D2D2D controls and subtle hover; #323232 control hover; #383838 selected navigation item; #3D3D3D stroke; #9A9A9A tertiary text and strong stroke; #C5C5C5 secondary text; #FFFFFF primary text

accessible_text_variants.note: Official values below WCAG AA 4.5:1 as text on these surfaces, nudged toward black (light) or white (dark) keeping the hue; enforced by tests/design-dna.test.ts.

font_families.heading: "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", "Selawik", "Noto Sans", system-ui, sans-serif
font_families.body: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", "Selawik", "Noto Sans", system-ui, sans-serif

typography.font_style_notes: Humanist sans with optical sizes (Text below 20px, Display above). Semibold 600 is the only emphasis weight; no uppercase section labels except small overlines.

spacing.section_rhythm: 12px inside cards, 24px between groups, 36px navigation items

layout.grid_system: NavigationView: left pane + content frame on a 4px grid

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px stroke on every control and card; text boxes add a darker bottom stroke

elevation.shadow_style: layered (ambient 2px blur + key shadow), used sparingly
elevation.depth_cues: material layers (Mica, Layer, Acrylic) and strokes; shadow only for flyouts and dialogs

iconography.style: outlined, Fluent System Icons / Segoe Fluent Icons look
iconography.preferred_set: Fluent System Icons (app keeps Phosphor/Lucide regular weight, which is visually close)

motion.entrance_pattern: fade + 8px slide up with decelerate curve
motion.exit_pattern: fade out, faster than entrance (accelerate cubic-bezier(1, 0, 1, 1))

components.button_style: Standard: ControlFill background, 1px stroke with darker bottom edge (ControlElevationBorder), 4px radius, 32px high. Accent: accent fill, white text, darker bottom edge.
components.input_style: Text box: ControlFill, 4px radius, 1px stroke, 1px strong bottom stroke; on focus the bottom becomes a 2px accent line and the field turns white. No outer glow.
components.card_style: CardBackground fill, 1px CardStroke, 8px radius, no shadow; hover lightens fill slightly.
components.navigation_pattern: NavigationView left pane: 36px items, 4px radius, selected = SubtleFillSecondary with a 3×16px accent pill inside the item's left edge.
components.modal_style: ContentDialog: 8px radius, Layer fill, shadow 'high', smoke overlay; command bar at the bottom on a slightly darker band.
components.list_style: List rows 40px, subtle hover fill, same accent pill for selection.
components.component_notes: ToggleSwitch 40×20: off = strong-stroke outline with 12px knob, on = accent fill with 12px white knob. Focus visual: 2px primary-text outline with 1px gap (keyboard only).

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: layered sheets of material on the desktop

visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: even; weight comes from the accent only

composition.grouping_strategy: cards on a layer, strokes between groups

interaction_feel.feedback_style: fill change on hover, darker on press

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: short explanation and a single accent button
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: factual, says what to do next

overview.fallback_strategy: reduce to CSS: Acrylic becomes an opaque fill when transparency is reduced

background_effects.description: Mica is emulated with its solid fallback colour; real Mica would need a transparent Electron window

visual_effects.composite_notes: Per WinUI guidance Mica belongs to long-lived window surfaces and Acrylic to transient light-dismiss surfaces: Acrylic is applied only to the typeahead/suggestion list. Mica uses its solid colours because the Electron window is opaque. Tertiary text was darkened from WinUI's #8B8B8B (3.5:1) to #6E6E6E to keep 12px hints at WCAG AA.
